# Find all stream objects with their dict

streams = []
for m in re.finditer(rb'(\d+) 0 obj\s*(<<.*?>>)\s*stream\r?\n', data, re.DOTALL):

    dicttext = m.group(2)
    start = m.end()
    end = data.find(b'endstream', start)
    raw = data[start:end]
    # remove trailing EOL before endstream
    raw = raw.rstrip(b'\r\n')
    streams.append((objnum, dicttext, raw))

print('found streams', len(streams))
for objnum, dicttext, raw in streams[:5]:
